caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally placed gravy boat rendered in shades of gray pencil on off-white paper. The gravy boat has an elongated, upward-curving spout on the left and a large, circular handle on the right. It rests on three legs, with the two forward legs shaped like stylized animal paws with decorative shell-like embellishments and the rear leg supporting the handle. Above the gravy boat, in the top left corner within a bordered frame, are the initials "MLO" written in a cursive script. In the bottom right corner, there is a smaller inset drawing of the same gravy boat in outline form. A thin, single-line border encloses the entire composition, and the artist’s name, "Michael Fong," is written near the bottom right corner adjacent to the border. The drawing is monochromatic, using fine lines and shading to convey the three-dimensional shape and reflective quality of the metal object.
title: Silver Pitcher
